text:
maria: Heads-up — mobile sample app observed streaming responses getting scrambled when on flaky cellular. small chunks arrive out of order and parser emits truncated JSON objects. repro on Android 11 emulator + real Pixel.

priya: ugh, seen that before? which SDK version?

maria: using android-sdk v0.9.2 (sampleapp). Node/JS client is fine in the same network. Android shows fragments like `\"{\"delta\":\"Hel\"\n` then later `\"lo\"}\n` but they get processed as two separate messages. sometimes order flips.

dan: can you paste a raw log (no pretty) from the sampleapp? also which transport — SSE or http2-stream?

maria: SSE (EventSource). raw log: 
```
[2026-03-15T14:12:03.123Z] RECV: data: {"id":"1","type":"chunk","payload":"{\"delta\":\"Hel\"}"\n\n"
[2026-03-15T14:12:03.326Z] RECV: data: {"id":"1","type":"chunk","payload":"lo\"}"\n\n"
[2026-03-15T14:12:03.330Z] PARSE_ERR: unexpected token l in json at position 0
```

maria: you can see the second fragment arrives later but parser already tried to decode first fragment.

priya: hmm, JS SSE SDK merges chunks until it sees the final `\n\n` delimiter and then passes a combined buffer to JSON.parse. Android's EventSource impl maybe handing each `data:` line separately. Also cellular stacks can re-segment TCP, so ordering and fragmentation are not guaranteed.

alex: sounds like an SDK parity bug — android-sdk shouldn't assume each `data:` payload is a full JSON message. need to implement incremental reassembly with a buffer keyed by stream id.

dan: agree. possible contributors: 1) EventSource client emitting per-line 2) our sampleapp extracting `payload` and attempting immediate parse 3) auth refresh/retry might replay partial fragments (we saw dup ids in other threads).

maria: i also noticed occasionally when auth refresh happens mid-stream the client reconnects and last-event-id isn't honored by the server edge, so fragments can duplicate and interleave. saw `sre-bot` deploy around same time.

sre-bot: Notice: edge deploy at 14:11:58 might have caused transient handshake delays in region us-west-2.

priya: ok plan: - implement incremental reassembly in android SDK parser (same approach as js-sdk) - buffer by stream id and only JSON.parse when buffer forms a complete JSON object (detect matching braces) - add unit+integration tests using harness that simulates re-segmentation and out-of-order fragments - short-term sampleapp patch to be defensive (try/catch and hold partials)

alex: for brace-matching easiest approach: track nesting counter, ignore `\"` strings state, treat escapes. not perfect but works for our generated payloads. simple pseudo: `for c in buf: if c==\"\\\" and not esc: toggle string; elif not in_string: if c==\"{\": depth++; elif c==\"}\": depth--;` when depth==0 emit.

priya: yes — but add limit on buffer size and a max waiting time to avoid memory blow. also record metrics when we hit reassembly for observability.

maria: i'll open a small repro in the sampleapp that toggles `adb shell svc data enable/disable` while stream running and attach logs.

dan: i'll own the integration test harness that feeds fragments in random order and delays. will add to eng-ci.

priya: i'll take the android-sdk change. estimate ~2 days + tests. will PR against `devx/reassembly-android`.

alex: assign reviewers: dan + maria. add changelog note about SDK parity and recommended upgrade.

maria: quick workaround for customers: set `streaming.buffer_mode = \"aggressive\"` in sampleapp config (defensive) and upgrade to 0.9.3-beta when we push.

dan: to confirm, this won't affect server-side ordering guarantees right? server still emits in order but network and client segmentation cause reassembly need.

priya: correct. server preserves order. fix is client-side reassembly.

maria: thanks — i'll post the repro artifact and logs here when ready. tagging @priya @dan :thumbsup:

priya: noted. creating ticket INF-1248 and linking here.

sre-bot: Ticket INF-1248 created by priya: "android sdk: incremental SSE reassembly and tests"
